passages.provision_quote: Resentencing pursuant to this section shall result in a lesser sentence than the one originally imposed as a result of the elimination of the repealed enhancement, unless the court finds by clear and convincing evidence that imposing a lesser sentence would endanger public safety.
passages.note: Authored repeal of specific pre-2018/2020 sentencing enhancements with mandatory resentencing to a lesser term; narrow in scope and shows direction but matches no rung's full clauses.
passages.actor_quote: SB 483, Allen. Sentencing: resentencing to remove sentencing enhancements.

rows.reasoning: SB 483, authored by Allen, declares specified pre-2018/2020 nonviolent-felony and drug sentencing enhancements 'legally invalid' and requires resentencing so that it 'shall result in a lesser sentence than the one originally imposed... unless the court finds by clear and convincing evidence that imposing a lesser sentence would endanger public safety.' This is narrow (specific enhancement categories only) and shows a lean toward less punitive sentencing, but it does not add treatment ('Focus on support and treatment, not punishment'), restitution or service ('through service or restitution'), a case-by-case standard, or added consequences, so it cannot establish any rung chair-shaped.
